embed.title: !script
embed.description: Export the tracking on your current profile as a list of commands. Paste them back to recreate the rules — as a backup, or to move them to another profile or server.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}script` — a short list comes back as a message; a long one as a file, `tracking_script.txt`.

You can paste many lines into one message: each line runs as a separate command. Paste a long file a section at a time.

fields.name: What's included
fields.value:
Rules for pokemon, raids, eggs, quests, invasions, lures, nests, gyms, max battles and fort updates, with their filters and settings (`template:`, `clean`, `edit`, `summary`, pings, `d:`, `location:`, `area:`).

Not included: your areas, location, saved locations, profile schedules, mutes and summary schedules. A rule with `location:home` needs a saved location called "home" wherever you paste it.

fields.name: Other profiles
fields.value: `{{prefix}}script` exports the profile you are on. To export another, switch first (`{{prefix}}profile 2`), then run `{{prefix}}script`.

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admins{{/if}}
fields.value: {{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}script user:<id>` — export another user's tracking. In a registered channel, `{{prefix}}script` exports the channel's.{{/if}}
